card.name: Time units after a number
card.fires_on: Time words such as months, weeks or years right after a number, mostly in contraception or washout-period instructions. Also fires on 'time' in 'time-consuming'.

modes.label: Months/weeks after number
modes.description: A time unit after a count, giving how long after the last dose to keep a precaution.
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception until 4<< months>> after the last dose.
